rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a film, book, or other creative work that becomes exceptionally popular and sells widely.

example.english: This film became a blockbuster as soon as it was released, and every screening was sold out.
example.traditional: 呢套戲一上畫就成為大熱作品，場場都爆滿。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 hei3 jat1 soeng5 waa2 zau6 sing4 wai4 daai6 jit6 zok3 ban2 coeng4 coeng4 dou1 baau3 mun5

rows.note: Use this for an ambitious, large-scale, usually high-budget work or event, even when exceptional popularity is not yet established.

example.english: This epic stage production is an ambitious blockbuster, with huge sums spent on promotion before opening.
example.traditional: 呢套史詩式舞台劇係大製作，未公演已經落重本宣傳。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 si2 si1 sik1 mou5 toi1 kek6 hai6 daai6 zai3 zok3 mei6 gung1 jin2 ji5 ging1 lok6 cung5 bun2 syun1 cyun4

rows.note: Use this for a large high-explosive bomb intended to destroy an extensive area.

example.english: When that blockbuster bomb hit the ground, the whole street shook.
example.traditional: 嗰枚大炸彈一落地，成條街都震晒。
example.jyutping: go2 mui4 daai6 zaa3 daan2 jat1 lok6 dei6 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 zan3 saai3
